source: All calibrated sensors in batch B passed test T. All sensors in tray C are calibrated sensors in batch B. Therefore all sensors in tray C passed test T.
expectations: Identify the valid universal chain under the stated premises.
Do not infer that tray C contains any sensors or that the premises are empirically verified.
knownBadRewrite: Therefore tray C contains sensors that passed test T.

source: All unicorns are horned. Therefore some horned creatures are unicorns. No existence premise is supplied.
expectations: State that the inference needs a nonempty-unicorn assumption.
Allow an empty unicorn class as a countermodel under modern predicate semantics.
knownBadRewrite: The conclusion follows from the universal premise alone.

source: Some devices with fault F restart. Unit A has fault F. Therefore unit A must restart.
expectations: Reject the move from some devices to this particular device necessarily restarting.
Retain the supplied fault premise without inventing a frequency.
knownBadRewrite: All devices with fault F restart.
